api_key.description: User-configured HTTP API key; empty disables protected HTTP access. Reload or restart after editing. Stored as plaintext here; CLI output redacts it.

cookie_import_key.description: Separate Bearer secret for userscript Cookie import; empty disables import. Never grants generation access.

data_dir.description: Defaults to data/ beside the executable. File-relative paths resolve from the configuration directory.

browser_executable.description: Explicit browser path, or empty to auto-detect the locked browser-runtime bundle beside the executable.

browser_backend.description: Default browser backend: the one new accounts are stored with (camoufox stores them as auto) and the one Cookie import verifies with. New configurations start on camoufox; a file without this field is an older installation and stays on cloakbrowser. Stored accounts keep their own backend, which changes only explicitly (accounts backend, or the fingerprint API). camoufox drives Camoufox over WebDriver BiDi with a Firefox identity generated per account. cloakbrowser is deprecated and will be removed in a later release. Applies without a restart.

proxy.description: Upstream proxy for the browser and for downloads. The browser can use a proxy with credentials only through browser_proxy_relay.

browser_proxy_relay.description: Route the browser through a local relay that authenticates to proxy (http:// or socks5://, with or without credentials) and only opens tunnels to port 443. Requires a restart.

browser_remote_allow_origins.description: Launch the browser with --remote-allow-origins=* so pages of any origin may open its loopback DevTools WebSocket. The gateway does not need it; only for external CDP tools. Requires a restart.

browser_site_isolation.description: Keep Chromium site isolation. false disables it to save renderer memory on small hosts, at the cost of cross-site process separation. Requires a restart.

headless.description: Run the browser without a window. Camoufox on Linux always runs with a display: an Xvfb virtual display when true, the desktop session's when false.

ignore_unsupported_parameters.description: Discard optional data API parameters explicitly unsupported by the upstream. Takes effect without restarting.

search_model_drop_functions.description: When a *-search model request carries function declarations, drop them and keep Google Search (true), or keep the caller's tools unchanged without injecting search (false). Takes effect without restarting.

continuation_retry_enabled.description: Retry ordinary continuation HTTP 403 denials received before any generation bytes. Does not disable normal continuation. Takes effect for the next generation without restarting.

browser_idle_seconds.description: Optional memory saving: stop the browser after this many seconds without any work; 0 keeps it running. The next request starts it again (cold start). Takes effect without restarting.

request_retention_days.description: Retain completed request details for this many days. Lifetime usage and estimated costs remain after expiry. Takes effect without restarting.

max_continuation_retries.description: Maximum extra empty-403 retries shared by all continuation rounds of one answer. Retained while continuation_retry_enabled is false. Takes effect for the next generation.

admin_key.description: Independent management Bearer secret; empty disables HTTP management. Newly created configurations use the default 'admin', which only works from local networks and must be replaced before other management use. Redacted in management output.

admin_origins.description: Exact HTTP(S) origins allowed for management; empty permits same-origin only. No paths, credentials or wildcards.
